movie.title: The Chase
movie.overview: 11 years ago, inspector Malik couldn’t solve a kidnapping case and a little girl died. Now with only a few days before the crime gets classified, he decides to reopen the case. Malik owes it to the mother and to himself. As he digs into the past, a child is kidnapped again. The pattern is the same one as a decade ago, it’s no coincidence. Malik knows he has a few days to make things right and to bring justice.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Facing the impending expiration of the statute of limitations, a tormented inspector reopens a tragic eleven-year-old cold case just as a new child abduction signals the return of the same kidnapper.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Eleven years after failing to save a young girl, Inspector Malik reopens her unresolved kidnapping case just days before it reaches its legal classification deadline. Driven by personal guilt and a promise to the victim's mother, his investigation takes a critical turn when another child disappears under identical circumstances. Realizing the original criminal has struck again, Malik races against the clock to solve both cases and deliver long-overdue justice.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Haunted by the tragic death of a young girl in an unsolved kidnapping from eleven years prior, Inspector Malik faces a ticking clock as the case approaches its statute of limitations. Determined to fulfill a solemn promise to the victim's grieving mother and redeem his own professional failure, he makes the controversial decision to reopen the files. Malik dives back into the cold evidence, systematically re-evaluating past mistakes and hunting for overlooked clues in the community. His resurgence in investigating the past coincides with a shocking new crime: another local child is suddenly abducted. Analyzing the fresh crime scene, Malik identifies identical operational patterns, proving beyond doubt that the original kidnapper has returned to action. With the local community in a panic and the official deadline to close the cold case rapidly approaching, Malik operates under immense pressure. He must navigate dead ends, escalating danger, and lingering internal grief to track down the perpetrator. Every hour counts as he aggressively pursues the suspect across the city, determined not to let history repeat itself. Ultimately, Malik turns his personal obsession into relentless momentum, risking everything to rescue the missing child and finally bring a predator to justice.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Eleven years ago, Inspector Malik suffered the defining failure of his career when he failed to solve a child kidnapping case, resulting in a young girl's tragic death. Now, with only a few days remaining before the case is officially closed due to the statute of limitations, Malik reopens the investigation to honor a promise to the victim's mother and seek personal redemption. As he revisits past evidence, a new child is abducted using the exact same modus operandi. Recognizing that the original criminal has resurfaced, Malik enters a high-stakes race against time to unravel the mystery, save the new victim, and bring a decade-old villain to justice.

story_structure.risingAction: Malik digs into past clues and current evidence, connecting the twin cases while trying to outmaneuver the perpetrator before time runs out.
